article.title: When principal may revoke agent’s authority.
article.content: The principal may, save as is otherwise provided by the last preceding section, revoke the authority given to his agent at any time before the authority has been exercised so as to bind the principal.
article.html:
203When principal may revoke agent’s authority.

Section 203 · Chapter X · Revocation of Authority · page 46 of the Act

The principal may, save as is otherwise provided by the last preceding section, revoke the authority given to his agent at any time before the authority has been exercised so as to bind the principal.
